id: title:TueHaulund:keep highlight posters across feed reloads

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application notification and feed interaction behavior
review.reason: The chunk implements UI and state management for the notification feed and read-marking behavior. P1.F1.H1 resets the read state of feed cards on reload, P1.F2.H3 allows the read-marking timer to reset when the underlying data key changes, and P1.F3.H4 distinguishes fresh loads from reloads in thumbnails to show loading skeletons. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement:
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the highlighted feed, loading state, or retry key, making it impossible to assess the tier of the change. The tier is assigned based on the observable, bounded improvements in the supplied hunks, not the complete implementation. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 2 broad capability is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the highlighted feed and picks loading, only the UI and the useAutoMarkRead hook. The P1.F7 hunks remove the feedLoadId from the key, but do not show the loading state or the retryKey implementation. This makes it impossible to assess the tier of the change.

observations.behavior: Adds a resetKey parameter to useAutoMarkRead, allowing the dwell timer to reset and fire again when the key changes.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the notification read-marking to reset and re-fire when the underlying data reloads, rather than only once per mount.

observations.behavior: Adds a retryKey parameter to ObservationThumbnail, allowing the component to distinguish between a fresh load and a reload, and to show a skeleton while loading.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the thumbnail to distinguish between a fresh load and a reload, and to show a skeleton while loading.

observations.behavior: Passes the feedLoadId as a resetKey to HighlightFeedRow, allowing the card to reset its read state on reload.
observations.code_quote: const { rerender } = renderHook(() => useAutoMarkRead(true, onDwell, AUTO_MARK_READ_DWELL_MS, resetKey))
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the card to reset its read state on reload, rather than only once per mount.
